scene: Babel BB-8 after battle — complete first draft

source.version_difference: CN and EN align at all 241 text-bearing positions by physical source line and type. EN has one additional terminal newline. The 549 non-text control commands match exactly. Speaker labels and localized text payloads differ by language. For the v3.25 selected range (CN/EN physical lines 712–782), all 71 normalized physical lines align after removing localized speaker labels and text payloads; the 41 text-bearing positions, command parameters, speaker slots, and markup-tag sequences align with no differences.

speaker_mappings.ru: Оракул (титул Доктора в воспоминании BB-8; рабочая форма)

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: Scareye insists that Ascalon did not kill him.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN recasts the opening as a rhetorical dismissal of the prophecy.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: Аскалон меня не убила! Не убила!
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian preserves the repeated CN assertion.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN calls the Cyclops Court a huge joke.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN adds the intensifier 'sick'.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: Королевский двор циклопов — одна большая шутка!
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian follows CN and omits the added adjective.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN repeats that Scareye did not die at Ascalon's hands, then refers to his own prophecy.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN compresses the repetition.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: Я не погиб от руки Аскалон. Не погиб так, как сам себе предсказывал…
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian keeps the repeated denial in a concise Russian form.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN says the mercenaries can return to the Scar Market and secure their position if Babel loses.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN reduces the consequence to 'nothing to lose'.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: …позаботиться о собственном положении.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian follows the CN reference to their position.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN explicitly identifies the men as ambushers Scareye himself placed there.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN calls them soldiers he set up for an ambush.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: …наёмников, которых сам же расставил здесь в засаде.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian retains the ambush and Scareye's responsibility.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN says Theresis respects compatriots who come before him one after another at the cost of their lives.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN adds an explanation about fighting their way out.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: …сородичей, которые один за другим пробивались к нему, ставя на кон собственную жизнь.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian follows the CN image without adding the EN explanation.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN says the traitors lying in ambush around them have probably prepared for a long time.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN adds the metaphor of sharpening their blades.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: …должно быть, готовились уже давно.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian follows CN and does not add the sharpening metaphor.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN identifies Manfred as a guard officer attached to the General; it does not specify the rank 'captain'.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN specifies 'guard captain'.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: Но я — офицер охраны генерала, ассасин.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian follows the less specific CN wording and does not add a rank.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN says she faces countless threats while in Kazdel.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN adds 'just as we are here'.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: Вы участвуете в гонке, а она в Казделе сталкивается с бесчисленными угрозами —
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian follows CN and omits the added EN comparison.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN calls the targets 刽子手, literally executioners.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN uses the freer term 'deathmongers'.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: …убейте меня, палачи.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian uses 'палачи' following CN.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN explicitly orders all inside agents/infiltrators to act and disarm patrol troops.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN generalizes this to all operations within the city.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: Передайте всем нашим агентам внутри города приказ действовать: разоружить патрульные отряды.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian preserves the CN reference to inside agents.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN explicitly says to defeat the forces one by one before they regroup.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN says to strike before they can regroup but omits the one-by-one detail.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: Разбейте их поодиночке, пока они не успели объединиться. Быстро.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian retains the CN instruction to defeat them individually.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN says the Sarkaz look toward the ruins 不约而同, acting in unison / as if by agreement.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN only says they gaze at the same ruins.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: …словно сговорившись, устремляли взгляды к руинам в центре города.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian preserves the CN detail of acting in unison.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN specifies damage to Kazdel's main urban districts (主城区).
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN uses the broader 'center city'.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: центральные районы Казделя
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian preserves the CN specification of the main urban area.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN uses 凄苦 as a compact expression of sorrow and suffering.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN expands this into 'sorrow, misery'.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: скорбь
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian keeps one compact emotional term rather than duplicating the idea.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN says there is no longer room for strategic gambits and calculations (博弈和算计); the assassins must be defeated directly.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN renders this as no wagering or planning our way out.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: никакие расчёты и уловки не помогут — остаётся лишь в открытом бою разгромить этих ассасинов
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian follows the CN emphasis on abandoning calculations and confronting the assassins directly.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN uses 心神 for the minds/consciousness linked by the elegy.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN uses 'minds'.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: погребальная песнь связывает наши сознания
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian preserves the mental/spiritual link rather than making it a physical connection.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN calls the Sarkaz a 弱势群体, a disadvantaged or vulnerable group.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN says 'weak community'.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: уязвимая общность
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian follows the CN sense of social vulnerability rather than implying inherent weakness.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN says the Sarkaz will corrupt the land with Originium (源石腐化大地).
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN uses the same broad image.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: сарказы заразят землю Ориджиниумом
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian expresses the land contamination in the established Originium terminology.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN describes a resilient race becoming believers/followers and the first bright bloodstain on the curtain over which Originium spreads.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN calls them followers and keeps the bloodstain metaphor.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: Такой стойкий народ стал нашими последователями — первым ярким кровавым пятном на полотне, по которому расползается Ориджиниум.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian preserves the full CN image and the explicit relation to the spread of Originium.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN uses the quoted phrase “文明的存续” (continuation/preservation of civilization).
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN renders the phrase as the proper name “Civilight Eterna”.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: «сохранение цивилизации»
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian follows the literal CN wording; the EN proper-name rendering is documented rather than silently substituted.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN uses 百亿, ten billion, for the number of compatriots sacrificed in the distant past.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN generalizes this to billions.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: десяти миллиардов сородичей
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian preserves the more specific quantity in CN.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN says the races are not united, not ideal, and not developed (不团结、不理想、不发达).
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN interprets 不理想 as narrow-minded.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: разобщены, далеки от идеала, неразвиты
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian follows the literal CN sequence and avoids importing the EN interpretation.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN uses the divine pronoun 祂 for the approaching entity.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN uses the neutral pronoun “It”.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: Он уже совсем близко.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian retains the elevated personal pronoun indicated by CN; the referent remains deliberately unnamed.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN compares the receding stars to leaves at night and does not explicitly say they tremble.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN adds “trembling”.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: словно листья в ночи
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian follows CN and does not add the motion from EN.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN calls Originium a score/notation (歌谱) written by the speakers and a melody offered to those who come after.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN condenses this into “our song”.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: партитура, которую мы написали, мелодия, оставленная тем, кто придёт после нас
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian preserves the musical-score image present in CN.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN explicitly frames the question around people willing to do anything to safeguard the interests of their own group (族群的利益).
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN broadens this to people willing to pay any price to defend their people.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: Как бы вы оценили тех, кто готов пойти на всё ради интересов своего народа?
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian retains the explicit CN reference to the group's interests.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN says tangible, living legends seem to become 泡影 in stories overnight when a brief era of peace arrives; 泡影 is an illusion or insubstantial shadow.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN says the living legends are relegated to the land of stories and tales.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: легенды, ещё недавно казавшиеся осязаемыми, словно превращаются в миражи из сказаний
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian preserves the CN contrast between tangible legends and their sudden insubstantiality.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: 魔王崩塌的车辇 identifies the collapsed chariot of the Demon King.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN renders the title as the King's chariot.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: Сохранён титул Короля Сарказ, а не буквальное «король демонов».
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: The contextual title is rendered consistently with the project's King of Sarkaz glossary.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: The previous King is named 以勒什.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN gives the name Yliš.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: Имя передано как «Илиш».
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: The spelling follows the Russian Arknights Wiki entry for Yliš.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: 疲惫地带兵回到故乡废墟 describes returning with troops to the homeland ruins while exhausted.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN characterizes the troops as defeated.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: Перевод говорит об измученном возвращении во главе войска, не добавляя отсутствующее в CN слово «побеждённые».
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: CN is primary; EN is used as a structural and naming cross-check.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: 从我的手中再传递给下一代 describes hatred being passed from Theresa's hands to the next generation.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN paraphrases this as hatred in her hand passing on.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: Сохранён образ передачи ненависти через руки Терезии следующему поколению.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: The Russian line follows the CN image and keeps the cyclical continuation.

notes: The original CN and EN game scripts were read from the attributed Kengxxiao mirrors; no complete source scripts are copied into this repository.
The full source contains 241 text-bearing positions: 141 named, 26 narration, 55 Sticker, two multiline, 12 Subtitle and five Decision positions.
CN has 790 physical lines; EN has 791 because of one extra terminal newline. All 241 text-bearing positions align by physical source line and type.
The 549 non-text control commands match exactly. Localized Sticker, Subtitle, Decision and multiline payloads are content, not command-structure differences.
This update translates ordinals 41–80, source lines 158–328: 27 named dialogue lines, seven narration lines and six Sticker text payloads.
The cumulative partial draft contains 80/241 positions. The next text position is ordinal 81 at CN source line 329.

Documented CN/EN meaning differences include Manfred's guard rank, the omitted EN comparison in Theresis's race metaphor, the term for executioners, the identity of inside agents, the one-by-one instruction, and the Sarkaz acting in unison.
The translated segment preserves all source command parameters and text-bearing command structure. No full CN/EN scripts are included.
The scene remains partial. Literary review and Yostar Global PC in-game validation have not been performed.
The v3.22 increment adds only source positions 81–120; the 80 v3.21 entries are preserved byte-for-byte at the JSON value level.
The two multiline lines at ordinals 95–96 remain separate source positions and were not merged.
The four countdown Sticker text payloads at ordinals 103–104 and 110–111 are translated; all surrounding Sticker control commands remain outside the translation JSON.
The 40 selected CN/EN text positions align by physical source line, type, and speaker slot. Non-text command lines in the selected range have no differences.
Mantra is a named Rhodes Island Elite Operator who previously joined Babel; the name is retained as Мантра.

The v3.23 increment translates ordinals 121–160 at CN/EN physical source lines 461–591: 14 named lines, 14 Sticker payloads and all 12 Subtitle payloads. No narration, multiline or Decision position occurs in this selected range.
The previous 120 Russian entries are preserved at the JSON value level. The cumulative partial draft is 160/241; next is ordinal 161 at CN line 592.

CN and EN were fetched from the attributed Kengxxiao repositories at the recorded refs. Both contain 241 text positions aligned by physical line and type; CN has 790 physical lines and EN 791 because of one extra terminal newline.

All 549 non-text control commands match exactly, including the selected range. The selected range has no control-command or markup-token differences; color tags and the {@nickname} placeholder are retained.
The quoted CN phrase 文明的存续 is translated literally as «сохранение цивилизации»; EN Yostar uses the proper-name rendering Civilight Eterna. This difference is documented and not silently normalized.
The CN quantity 百亿 is rendered as ten billion, and the divine pronoun 祂 is rendered with a capitalized personal pronoun. These choices follow the Chinese source; EN differences are recorded.
All 12 Subtitle positions are now translated. Five Decision options remain untranslated after ordinal 160.
No complete CN or EN source scripts are stored in the repository. Literary review and Yostar Global PC in-game validation have not been performed.
The v3.24 increment translates ordinals 161–200 at CN/EN physical source lines 592–708: six named dialogue lines, two narration lines, 27 Sticker payloads, and all five Decision options.
The previous 160 Russian entries are preserved at the JSON value level. The cumulative partial draft is 200/241; the next text position is ordinal 201 at CN source line 712.
The five Decision options are now translated. Both multiline positions and all 12 Subtitle positions were already translated in earlier increments.

For the selected CN/EN source range 592–708, all 117 normalized lines align after removing localized name and text payloads; no command parameter, speaker-slot, or markup-tag structure differences were found.
CN wording at ordinal 197 explicitly mentions safeguarding the interests of the group; ordinal 200 retains the CN image of tangible legends turning into insubstantial illusions (泡影).
No complete CN/EN source scripts are stored in the repository. Literary review and Yostar Global PC in-game validation have not been performed.
The v3.25 increment translates ordinals 201–241 at CN/EN physical source lines 712–782: 33 named dialogue lines, four narration lines, and four Sticker payloads.
The previous 200 Russian entries are preserved at the JSON value level. All 241/241 text-bearing positions are now translated; the BB-8 after-battle first draft is complete.

For selected CN/EN physical lines 712–782, all 71 normalized lines align after removing localized speaker labels and text payloads. The 41 text positions, speaker slots, command parameters, and markup tags match; no structural differences were found.
The name 以勒什 is rendered as Илиш, following the Russian Arknights Wiki. The CN description of the troops returning exhausted is retained instead of EN's 'defeated troops'.
No complete CN/EN source scripts are stored in the repository. Literary review and Yostar Global PC in-game validation have not been performed.
В позиции 211 сохранены оба компонента CN 遗落者 и 销声匿迹: те, кто остался позади и бесследно исчез.
В позиции 234 не добавлено отсутствующее в CN прямое слово «война»: образ волны передан как «подхватит их и увлечёт за собой».

external_references.claim: Русская Arknights Wiki передаёт имя Yliš (以勒什) как «Илиш» и указывает его как предшественника Терезии на посту Короля Сарказ.
external_references.use: Сверка русской формы имени в позиции 225; игровой CN остаётся первичным источником смысла.
